attachment-tests.json.scope: Native constructor callback and sequential/staged native suspend/resume mutators; Objective-C factories, hierarchy effects, geometry getters/setters, ARC accounting, mutex boundaries and journal sink modeled. Factory/init internals and UIKit exceptions not executed. Paused native callback register context restored around a separate-stack native lifecycle mutator; no real concurrency or asynchronous block ownership.

cache-guard-tests.json.scope: Native enqueueReusableBuffer: entry guard and rejecting normal exits, or stop before accepted cache-body synchronization. Underlying buffer/length getters and ARC accounting modeled. Accepted cache insertion, locking, enumeration, capacity policy and real allocator/Metal behavior not executed.

completion-tests.json.scope: Native completion-block copy/dispose/invoke helpers with manually prepared blocks. ARC counters, zeroing-weak resolutions and enqueueReusableBuffer: effect modeled. A live-to-nil weak sequence is forced, not proven reachable under real owner lifetime. Native buffer-cache insertion, GPU completion, actual Blocks runtime copying and concurrency not executed.

factory-attachment-tests.json.scope: Native admitted constructor composed with native shared factory/once block/publication prefix, then native suspend on a separate stack before callback resumes. Each invocation starts from seeded eligible state. dispatch_once, ObjC/runtime, rest of init, property ownership and hierarchy effects remain modeled; attempted addSubview:nil is recorded without throwing. No asynchronous/runtime proof.

factory-tests.json.scope: Native shared factory, native once block and native initializer publication prefix. dispatch_once completion/token state modeled explicitly; no real dispatch_once or concurrency. Allocation, rest of initialization, ObjC property implementations, ARC and journal boundaries modeled. Pointer identities are symbolic; no real pointer lifetime guarantee.

provenance: Fresh rerun of repository-adapted tests; original findings used Capstone 5.0.9. No original or R03 binary was modified. Counts are labeled model cases, not independent end-to-end paths.
